newsitem.title: CHINA: China closes two rubber delivery warehouses.
newsitem.headline: China closes two rubber delivery warehouses.

text.p: The China Commodity Exchange said it was closing two of its rubber warehouses on Wednesday.
The warehouses were full and needed re-arranging, the exchange, based in the southern province of Hainan, said in the statement faxed to Reuters.
The closure of the warehouses was bad news for shorts, traders said, because less rubber would be available for delivery against the August 1997 contract.
Confrontation between longs and short in the August contract has led to wide fluctuations in recent weeks.
Traders said open interest was still high at 124,794 lots after falling almost 60,000 lots during trading on Wednesday.
The exchange also announced on Wednesday a sharp increase in the margin requirement in the August contract.
The contract ended Wednesday at 12,225 yuan per tonne, down 400 yuan from Tuesday's close.
